import json, signal, sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
s=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); driver=None
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('Hierarchy deadline'))); signal.alarm(50)
try:
    options=webdriver.ChromeOptions(); options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
    for flag in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1200']: options.add_argument(flag)
    driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options);driver.set_page_load_timeout(8);wait=WebDriverWait(driver,6)
    driver.get(s['url']);name,value=s['cookie'].split('=',1);driver.add_cookie({'name':name,'value':value,'path':'/'})
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument',{'source':"window.originalFetch=fetch.bind(window);window.fetch=(url,options)=>{const result=window.originalFetch(url,options);return window.hold&&String(url).includes(window.hold)&&String(url).includes('cursor=')?result.then(r=>new Promise(resolve=>window.release=()=>resolve(r))):result}"})
    driver.get(s['url']+'/?tree-proof=1#/projects/'+s['projectId']+'/issues')
    def button(text):return wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="'+text+'"]')))
    def item(id):return wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="treeitem"][data-issue-id="'+id+'"]')))
    def focused(id):wait.until(lambda d:d.execute_script('return document.activeElement.dataset.issueId')==id)
    button('Hierarchy view').click();wait.until(lambda d:len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="tree"] > [role="treeitem"]'))==20)
    button('Load more root issues').click();wait.until(lambda d:len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="tree"] > [role="treeitem"]'))==25)
    q=driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[name="q"]');q.send_keys('Explore root');wait.until(lambda d:len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="treeitem"]'))==1)
    root=item(s['rootId']);root.send_keys(Keys.ARROW_RIGHT);focused(s['firstChildId']);item(s['firstChildId']).send_keys(Keys.ARROW_RIGHT);focused(s['deepId'])
    assert item(s['deepId']).get_attribute('aria-level')=='3'
    item(s['deepId']).send_keys(Keys.ARROW_LEFT);focused(s['firstChildId']);item(s['firstChildId']).send_keys(Keys.ARROW_LEFT);assert item(s['firstChildId']).get_attribute('aria-expanded')=='false'
    item(s['firstChildId']).send_keys(Keys.HOME);focused(s['rootId']);item(s['rootId']).send_keys(Keys.END)
    button('Load more children').click();wait.until(lambda d:len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="treeitem"]'))==24)
    focused(s['laterChildId'])
    root=item(s['rootId']);root.send_keys(Keys.HOME,Keys.ARROW_LEFT);wait.until(lambda d:len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="treeitem"]'))==1)
    root.send_keys(Keys.ARROW_RIGHT);focused(s['firstChildId'])
    driver.execute_script('window.hold=arguments[0]', 'parentId='+s['rootId']);button('Load more children').click();wait.until(lambda d:d.execute_script('return Boolean(window.release)'))
    driver.execute_script('location.hash=arguments[0]','/projects/'+s['crossId']+'/issues');button('Hierarchy view').click();wait.until(lambda d:'Other project root' in d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="tree"]').text)
    driver.execute_script('window.hold=null;window.release()');assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="treeitem"]'))==1
    assert 'Explore root' not in driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'[role="tree"]').text
    print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'checks':['root later page','root filters and complete descendants','keyboard depth and focus','child later page','collapse ownership','delayed project switch']}))
except Exception:
    if driver:print(json.dumps({'body':driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text,'url':driver.current_url}),file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:driver.quit()
